readings: For each invoice, compute its average line product cost (AVG of `derived_product_cost`) and its ratio as the average of the per-line ratios `derived_total_cost` / `product_price`. Skip lines where either value is NULL, and skip lines where `product_price` is 0. Compute the overall average ratio as the plain average of these per-invoice ratios across all invoices. Keep the invoices whose ratio is strictly above that overall average. In a single row, return the average of their average line product costs, the average of their ratios, and the average of (invoice ratio minus overall average ratio) across them. Do not round.

For each invoice, compute its average line product cost (AVG of `derived_product_cost`) and its ratio as the invoice's average `derived_total_cost` divided by its average `product_price`, i.e. a ratio of per-invoice averages, ignoring NULL values in each column. Compute the overall average ratio as the plain average of these per-invoice ratios across all invoices. Keep the invoices whose ratio is strictly above that overall average. In a single row, return the average of their average line product costs, the average of their ratios, and the average of (invoice ratio minus overall average ratio) across them. Do not round.
queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost / product_price) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND product_price IS NOT NULL
    AND derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND product_price <> 0
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_of_avg_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS avg_diff
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.ratio > overall.avg_ratio;
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / AVG(product_price) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_cost,
       AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(inv.ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS avg_diff
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.ratio > overall.avg_ratio;
